_comment: Speed screen: does this archetype terminate inside the 40,960-token context budget? The Azorius mirror did not -- 18.2 decisions/turn, 13/20 aborted at the ceiling. Boros runs at 8.9 dec/turn and 9.6 turns. deckType Freeform because these are 2011-2014 tournament decks: Freeform.java validates size only, no set legality, and every card ships with XMage so it is guaranteed implemented -- which a downloaded decklist is not.
